title: Bihar Secondary Teacher Eligibility Test BSEB STET 2026 Apply Online Date
vacancyDetails: Bihar Secondary Teacher Eligibility Test (STET) 2026 notification for Paper I and Paper II eligibility examination.
qualification: Bachelor's or Master's degree in the relevant subject with B.Ed as per NCTE norms; detailed subject-wise eligibility is given in the official notification.
ageLimit: Minimum age 18 years; maximum age 37 years for male and 42 years for female as on 01/08/2026; age relaxation as per Bihar Board rules.
applicationFee: Single Paper: General / BC / EWS ₹960; SC / ST / PH ₹760. Both Papers: General / BC / EWS ₹1440; SC / ST / PH ₹1140. Fee can be paid only online.
selectionProcess: Online application → STET examination (Paper I / Paper II) → result declaration → teacher eligibility / further process as per BSEB rules
documentsRequired: Class 10th mark sheet and certificate, Class 12th certificate and mark sheet, graduation certificate and mark sheet, post-graduation certificate and mark sheet, B.Ed certificate and mark sheet, photograph, signature, category certificate if required, domicile certificate if required, and other relevant eligibility documents
howToApply:
1. Visit the official STET registration portal
2. Register using mobile number and email ID
3. Fill the application form carefully
4. Upload photo, signature and all required documents
5. Pay the application fee online
6. Submit the form and keep the final printout for reference
shortDescription: Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB) has released the Secondary Teacher Eligibility Test STET 2026 notification. The application window is open from 17 August 2026 to 22 September 2026 (extended date).
content:
Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB) has released the Secondary Teacher Eligibility Test (STET) 2026 notification.

Applications are open from 17/08/2026 to 22/09/2026 (date extended). Candidates must review the full official notice before applying to ensure subject-wise eligibility, fee requirements and exam pattern.

Important Dates

  • Application Begin: 17/08/2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online: 22/09/2026 (Date Extended)
  • Pay Exam Fee Last Date: 15/09/2026
  • Paper I Exam Date: As per schedule
  • Paper II Exam Date: As per schedule
  • Admit Card: Before exam
  • Result: Notified soon

Application Fee

Single Paper

  • General / BC / EWS: ₹960
  • SC / ST / PH: ₹760

Both Papers

  • General / BC / EWS: ₹1440
  • SC / ST / PH: ₹1140

Fee is to be paid online only through debit card, credit card or net banking.
